style="text;html=1;strokeColor=none;fillColor=none;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;whiteSpace=wrap;rounded=0;fontSize=16;" parent="1" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry x="180" y="675" width="400" height="25" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="how-text" value="<font color="#94A3B8">Instead of predicting future rewards, GRPO simply <b>compares responses within a group</b>:<br><br>1. Generate multiple responses for the same prompt<br>2. Score each response with the reward model<br>3. <b>Reinforce responses that scored above the group average</b><br>4. Penalize responses below average<br><br>Simple comparison = no need for value prediction!</font>" style="text;html=1;strokeColor=none;fillColor=none;align=left;verticalAlign=top;whiteSpace=wrap;rounded=0;fontSize=12;" parent="1" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry x="110" y="700" width="560" height="105" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="insight-bg" value="" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#1E293B;strokeColor=#22D3EE;strokeWidth=3;" parent="1" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry x="710" y="660" width="600" height="160" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="insight-title" value="<font color="#22D3EE"><b>Why This Matters</b></font>" style="text;html=1;strokeColor=none;fillColor=none;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;whiteSpace=wrap;rounded=0;fontSize=16;" parent="1" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry x="900" y="675" width="220" height="25" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="insight-text" value="<font color="#94A3B8">Training large LLMs with RL is <b>extremely expensive</b>. GRPO's simplification means:<br><br><b>Lower cost</b> - Less GPU memory needed<br><b>Faster iteration</b> - Simpler architecture = quicker experiments<br><b>More accessible</b> - Teams with fewer resources can train RL models<br><br>DeepSeek proved you don't need complexity to get great results!</font>" style="text;html=1;strokeColor=none;fillColor=none;align=left;verticalAlign=top;whiteSpace=wrap;rounded=0;fontSize=12;" parent="1" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry x="730" y="705" width="560" height="105" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="vs-bg" value="" style="ellipse;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#1E293B;strokeColor=#F59E0B;strokeWidth=4;aspect=fixed;" parent="1" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry x="660" y="355" width="80" height="80" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="vs-text" value="<font color="#FFFFFF"><b>VS</b></font>" style="text;html=1;strokeColor=none;fillColor=none;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;whiteSpace=wrap;rounded=0;fontSize=24;" parent="1" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry x="670" y="375" width="60" height="40" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </root> </mxGraphModel> </diagram> </mxfile>

font.b: How GRPO Replaces the Value Model

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 558px; height: 1px; padding-top: 657px; margin-left: 62px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #000000;
display: inline-block; font-size: 12px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#000000, #ffffff); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;
div.font:
Instead of predicting future rewards, GRPO simply compares responses within a group:
1. Generate multiple responses for the same prompt
2. Score each response with the reward model
3. Reinforce responses that scored above the group average
4. Penalize responses below average
Simple comparison = no need for value prediction!

Training large LLMs with RL is extremely expensive. GRPO's simplification means:
Lower cost - Less GPU memory needed
Faster iteration - Simpler architecture = quicker experiments
More accessible - Teams with fewer resources can train RL models
DeepSeek proved you don't need complexity to get great results!
